comment: Dependencies that the weekly upkeep does not update (R6). Each entry has `name` (the exact crate or package name) or `prefix` (the start of the name), and a `reason`. `holdsDependencies: true` also holds the crates that only held crates with this setting use (R6: the native, audio, platform API, Keychain and updater crates). The Rig rules do not have it. select-updates.ts also holds the exact pins in the Cargo.toml files and package.json; exact pins do not hold their dependencies. block2 and dispatch2 are in the objc2 family of macOS API crates, so they are held as platform API crates.
